headline: Fuel, Lega-FI clash. Tajani: "Very opposed to windfall profits, like in the USSR"
summary: Lega and Forza Italia clashed over windfall profits in the fuel sector. Deputy Prime Minister Antonio Tajani said he was strongly opposed to windfall profits.
why: Windfall taxes on energy companies alter the profitability and fiscal outlook for fuel producers and retailers, and shape government revenue decisions.
